top_signals.title: Is AI a Bubble? Wall Street Titans Say Not Even Close
top_signals.summary: Finance heavyweights including Goldman CEO David Solomon, Franklin Templeton's Jenny Johnson, Morgan Stanley's Ted Pick broadly dismissed fears that the AI boom has entered bubble territory, while Pimco chief Emmanuel Roman noted the sector's debt wave has yet to distort broader credit markets. They spoke to Bloomberg Television on the sidelines of the HKMA Global Financial Leaders' Summit. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: XRG to Buy Shell’s Stake in Australian Project for $1.45 Billion
top_signals.summary: The energy investment arm of Abu Dhabi’s state oil producer agreed to pay $1.45 billion for Shell Plc’s stakes in an Australian natural gas project, the latest in a series of deals as it seeks to expand around the world.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
